active_phases.name: the research slice kind and Aside-driven browser verification
active_phases.objective: Add `research` to the closed SLICE_KINDS set as a findings-only slice -- no product code, always routed to slice-executor-high -- whose output lands in phase.md so the DECOMP2 slice that normally follows can re-cut the remaining work from what was learned, generalizing the second decomposition pass beyond the build-after design style. And make Aside (CLI / MCP / REPL) the workspace's prescribed instrument for real-browser verification -- the functional sweep, fidelity slices, and the review's own product walk -- in place of scripted Playwright-style automation.
